programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie's daughter, Rose, is coming to stay for a month, and it's the first time they've seen each other in two years. Stevie hopes to rebuild their relationship, but Rose is clear that she is only here for work experience.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Rose secretly begins seeing Leo, unaware of his history with Stevie. Meanwhile, Riley, Alex, Jodi and Kate take cattle along the stock route overnight.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After Rose and Stevie enthusiastically prepare dinner for Rose's "mystery man," the girls are horrified when they see whom the date turns out to be. Meanwhile, Kate wants to apply for the Young Farmer of the Year award but is crushed when she learns that Jodi has entered as well since Kate has never beaten Jodi at anything.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi has introduced Boer goats onto Drovers and wants to associate them with Gungellan Fresh. Phil Rakich is instantly opposed to the idea and bad mouths the animals, which causes tension with Riley.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Alex returns from the city with Fiona, Stevie fears he's changed his mind about leaving his wife. Meanwhile, Jodi and Patrick fight over who knows Kate the best.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: During a storm, Jodi wakes from a nightmare about fleeing from the hitman with Rob. Stevie wakes alone and full of remorse, while Alex wakes up in his ute, heartbroken after seeing Stevie with another man.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After a group of brumbies are found shot dead, the girls of Drovers Run suspect a handsome stranger named Riley. Meanwhile, Sandra moves back into Killarney in hopes of carrying out Harry's legacy while Alex is absent

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Stevie and Riley have gone into partnership to train the brumbies they saved from the national park, but they clash over techniques when they must have a horse ready for sale in one day. Meanwhile, Sandra and Fiona realise they're at a stalemate when they both secure damaging information about the other.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Regan's horse-riding lessons have paid off. She is feeling confident in her ability and excited by the prospect of riding with the Drovers Cross Country team. After a mistake, Regan discovers that Drovers Run lost a contract to Sandra because she caused a paratyphoid outbreak in some cattle.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: When evidence begins to mount against Stevie, Kate starts to believe that she could be the cause of Harry Ryan's death and must decide if she should go to the police with her suspicions. Meanwhile, Riley learns a local trainer abuses his horses and plans to do something about it.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Kate, who went to the police with her suspicions about Stevie's involvement in Harry's death, struggles to deal with the consequences of her actions. Alex returns from Argentina to find much has changed since he left, and he's got a lot to handle straight away.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are determined to discover who killed Harry Ryan. When Leo returns to the district and locks horns with Stevie, she becomes convinced that he is the killer. Meanwhile, Alex discovers that Fiona has lied about her pregnancy.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Taking a short cut along the stock route, Moira is horrified when her petrol tanker has a dangerous fuel spill on Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi and Kate struggle to make a decision about the future of the ranch given the possibility that Stevie may go to jail.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: Steve is busy trying to tie up loose ends before her trial begins, and Fiona joins the CFS in an attempt to show Alex how she can integrate herself into the town. When Alex and Riley are away from Killarney, doors all over the property are left open.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: Life Partners
programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

programme.title: Swan Song
programme.desc: A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

programme.title: The Napa Boys
programme.desc: A mysterious individual known as "The Sommelier" leads a group of friends on a raucous road trip through wine country.

programme.title: Tapawingo
programme.desc: When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

programme.title: Support the Girls
programme.desc: Lisa is the general manager of Double Whammies, a sports bar that features skimpily dressed waitresses. Always nurturing and protective of her staff, she soon faces one trying day that tests her optimism at every turn.

programme.title: The Great Buck Howard
programme.desc: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

programme.title: Permanent
programme.desc: Aurelie, 13, dreams about getting a perm so that she can finally fit in at her small-town Virginia school. Things soon go incredibly wrong when her clueless parents bring her to a beauty school to save a few bucks.

programme.title: Deadfall
programme.desc: En route to Canada with stolen casino loot, a thief (Olivia Wilde) separates from her brother (Eric Bana) and falls in with a boxer (Charlie Hunnam) who's on his way home for Thanksgiving.

programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When talking about a juicy steak, grilling often comes to mind but for Lidia, it's all about the sear. In today's episode, Lidia begins with a crispy Montasio Cheese Frico stuffed with potatoes and onions. She then makes a Seared Steak with a perfectly balanced sauce of rosemary, shallots and mixed mushrooms. Her side dish is a Braised Escarole with olive oil, pepperoncino and garlic -simple and delicious.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shows how to mix and balance seasonal flavors from your own garden in order to create new recipes based on what's available.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When it's cold outside, Lidia's kitchen kicks into high gear. The oven is on and the stovetop is always lit. On today's menu, she'll prepare her Turkey Meatloaf with Mushroom Sauce -a real family favorite that is smothered in mushroom sauce. Vin Brulee is a mulled wine infused with warm spices; it's the perfect choice to warm up on a cold night.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved artichoke, spinach and mortadella salad; mussels, sausage and potatoes in white wine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter minestrone; roasted squash and carrot salad with chickpeas and almonds.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dishes using ricotta, including bruschetta, crespelle manicotti and chocolate chip ricotta cookies.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Eating In With Lidia
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement, even though she had to flee there to avoid the communist regime in her hometown of Pula. She and her family stayed with her Zia Nina, whose influence on Lidia's cooking is still seen in her recipes today. Recipes include Mussels Triestina, Orange & Raspberry Spritz, and a Coffee Panna Cotta made with a light, sweetened cream.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia as she shares holiday traditions with four families across America. From New York to San Antonio and San Francisco, celebrate Christmas, Passover, and Chinese New Year with Mo Rocca, Stanley Tucci, Ruth Reichl, and more!
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday Tables & Traditions

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When hosting an Italian-style cocktail party, all you need is some drinks, a nice selection of appetizers, and you're set! Back in the kitchen, Lidia creates a menu for the perfect cocktail party. She makes Mussels with Zucchini Salsa Verde, a small appetizer guests can slurp down while sipping on a cocktail. She then makes Bloody Mary, a classic cocktail everyone loves. Corn and apricots work wonderfully together, and Lidia ends with making Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves cooking for her family and today, she shares some of her favorite recipes to make for her grandkids, including a refreshing and kid-friendly Cherry Almond Spritzer; a simple dessert of Grilled Fruit, which brings out the fruit's natural sweetness; and Pasta Salad with Green Beans, Tomatoes and Mozzarella, a great dish for buffets, picnics, and large family gatherings.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Comfort food is loved in America, and today, Lidia shares comfort foods Italians love to make. Beef and Potato Goulash, made with sweet Hungarian paprika, is a great recipe for family gatherings. Salads are a favorite of Lidia's, and Country Salad is a welcomed addition to any buffet table. She ends on a sweet note with a luscious Hazelnut Parfait.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Family favorites are the topic in this episode. Lidia starts with a Penne "Al Brucio" made with a spicy tomato sauce, rosemary and a dollup of fresh ricotta. She also shares her famous chicken cacciatore recipe and talks about the best way to make garlic bread. For those looking for a refreshing drink, Lidia shares a delicious and fresh prosecco punch.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are so many varieties of cheese in Italy, and today's recipes feature some delicious ones. Lidia will make a Crostata with Mushrooms and Onion; A quick Salad and Chicken "Involtini" with Kale Pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dandelion and chickpea salad; one-pan chicken and aubergine Parmigiana.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta is a staple in any Italian home and today, Lidia prepares three pasta recipes that will become staples in your kitchen. The first dish on the menu is a quick Ziti with Kale Pesto and Crispy Bacon, a delicious way to recycle any kale pesto leftovers in the fridge. She then makes a delicious summertime pasta made with plum tomatoes, Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto, and finally Campanelle with Shrimp and Fennel, made with "little bells" that carry the chunky sauce so well.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Building the ultimate Italian cheeseboard; skilled sausage and peppers; St. Joseph's zeppole, fried dough filled with vanilla cream topped with Amarena cherries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia grew up along the Adriatic sea so picnics at the beach were a common occurrence. Recipes in this episode include some seafood classics from the southern part of Italy including Orecchiette with Peas and Asparagus; Mussels with Farro, Cannellini and Chickpeas and a quick and delicious Chocolate Fig dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes Season 1
programme.desc: In this moving special, acclaimed chef and food ambassador Lidia Bastianich pays homage to the men and women of our military and the truly life-saving sacrifices they make daily for our freedom. Lidia meets seven veterans, who share their incredibly inspiring stories.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Holiday for Heroes

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mushroom ragu; Moka coffee; Kaiserschmarrn, a light and fluffy eggy pancake topped with jam.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter panzanella; a mix of warm roasted vegetables tossed with bread and kale; crespelle bar; farina gnocchi.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rome is one of Lidia's favorite cities, and today's episode features some Roman classic techniques. Recipes include Scallops Saltimbocca and Seared Lamb Chops with Mint Salsa Verde and Roasted Potato Wedges.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia cooks up two Italian American favorites today in her kitchen- Lasagna with Ricotta and Fresh Mozzarella, baked to golden perfectionand Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks, pan fried and made with fresh tomato sauce and mozzarella. To round out the menu, she'll share a Perfect Simple Salad, traditionally eaten at the end of the meal in her Italian kitchen.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Striped bass with broccolini; roasted pepper and olive salad; tomato tart with pecorino Romano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grandma Erminia's favorites grace today's menu and include a Rice & Pea Soup; a simple Prosciutto Cotto sandwich and a dish that the family finds on many Sunday menus: Baked Stuffed Shells.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mussel bruschetta; a tasting of olive oil; spaghetti in lemon cream sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: On today's menu, Lidia serves Chicken and Sausage Bites with Apple Cider Vinegar Sauce, made with rosemary, vinegar, and honey. Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Eggs were always a favorite at Lidia's home as a kid and they still are. In this episode, she'll prepare Savory Egg Battered Zucchini Roll Ups; a refreshing and simple Fennel, Red Onion and Celery Salad topped with Italian Salami and a luscious Frittata Filled with Ricotta, Tomatoes, Onion and Basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.
