programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita habla con Pilar y le dice que se la pasa bien con Tomás, pero con el solo escuchar el nombre de Nico, todo se le olvida. El padre de Diego le regala un auto lo cual le molesta, porque solo trata de comprar su cariño.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Valeria le propone a Franco vivir juntos, él le dice que lo ha pensado, pero no puede porque Mía es su prioridad y debe estar libre para ella. Debido a la ruptura de Nico y Karen, el padre de ella le prohíbe ir al café y olvidarse de la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La banda se entera de que Gastón estuvo en el café y los vio tocar. Galia habla con Pilar y le dice que cada una deberá enfrentar sus errores. Mía pelea con Miguel por culpa de Luz Viviana, ella amenaza con contarle a su papá que está en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni logra escapar de La Logia, Miguel y los demás chicos denuncian con el director que Giovanni y Teo no están en el colegio. Tomás y Lupita están discutiendo y escuchan un golpe.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Afortunadamente, Teo no está muerto, Enrique y los chicos lo reaniman mientras esperan a los paramédicos. Carlo le dice a Alma que alguien debe poner a Roberta en su lugar. Pascual no cree sobre la existencia de La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: José visita a Teo en el hospital y le dice que lo ama. Alma toma la decisión de irse debido al comportamiento de Roberta. Giovanni les confiesa que sabe dónde están los archivos de La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La habitación de la azotea arde en llamas, Pascual y Galia corren para controlar el fuego, sin saber que Diego y los demás alumnos. El director Pascual y Mendiola no saben qué hacer con los alumnos que forman La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual y el Lic. Mendiola llegan a un acuerdo para que nadie se entere sobre "La Logia". Roberta trata de hablar con su madre, pero Alma sigue muy dolida. Giovanni es expulsado del colegio. Pilar se confiesa con su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Enrique le hace saber a todo el colegio que la escuela opera bajo una logia y León sugiere clausurar el colegio. Carlo le propone una nueva oportunidad de trabajo en Estados Unidos a Alma. Juan discute con su papá por haberse unido a la logia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel ya no quiere trabajar para Franco, pero él le pide que vaya con Mía. Mía le pide a Alma que hable con su papá para que la deje cantar en el grupo. Alma le confiesa a Franco que sus hijos falsificaron sus firmas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Ante el problema de la gaceta, Miguel defiende a Mía y dice que él es su novio. Roberta le dice a Luján que Teo se muere por ella, pero Luján no le cree. Gastón agradece a Miguel por haber dicho que él es el novio de Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El director del colegio le informa a Enrique que está despedido, pero él no quiere. Durante la cena, Mía pierde el control y al destapar la champaña, moja a todos. Luz intenta seducir a Miguel en el baño de hombres, pero Mía entra y le pega a Luz.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le reclama a Miguel que vaya a salir con Luz Viviana. Gastón se enfurece al descubrir a Miguel y Mía besándose. Todos los chicos se sorprenden al encontrarse en su viaje a Canadá. Franco se entera de que Carlos y Alma piensan vivir en Nueva York.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco se encuentra a Alma en un restaurante, pero se entera su novia y se molesta. Lupita le cuenta a Pilar que Tomás la besó. Mia le propone a Diego tener un romance en Canadá, al igual que Miguel a Roberta. Enrique tiene una discusión con Renata.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico, Celina y José pretenden juntar a Mía con Miguel y a Roberta con Diego. Teo insiste en que José sea su novio. Todos esquían en la nieve y se divierten. Alma está triste por Roberta. La mamá de Miguel busca a Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gandía despide a Madariaga del colegio. Mía se pone celosa por Roberta, pero Miguel le confiesa que ellos son solo amigos. Pepa le confiesa a Alma que Roberta ya sabe que se irá a vivir a Nueva York y llora por eso. Diego besa a Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel se besan, pero Gastón los interrumpe con una llamada. Por su parte, Madariaga recuerda las clases en la escuela y se pone nostálgico. Además, Diego confunde a Roberta con Paola.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Renata acusa a Madariaga de ser un asesino. Georgi le confiesa a Roberta el inmenso amor que siente por Luján. Roberta y sus compañeros del colegio idean un plan para demostrarle a Renata que Madariaga es un buen hombre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mendiola le exige a Pascual que expulse a Madariaga del colegio. Roberta y Mía sospechan que Alma y Franco están enamorados. Renata le confiesa a Plutarco que Mendiola es su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le cuenta a la prensa el amor y la admiración que siente por Alma. Alma decide detener su gira internacional para poder pasar más tiempo con Roberta. Teo idea un plan para saber si Luján está interesada en Georgi.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta besa a Facundo para agradecerle por todo el apoyo que le ha dado. Tres mujeres se aprovechan del estado de ebriedad de Diego, Giovanni y Tomás para robarles su dinero. Gastón lleva a cabo sus planes para alejar a Miguel y Mia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego se encela al saber que Roberta está saliendo con Facundo. Nico se alegra al saber que Lupita no ha dejado de amarlo. Mía idea un plan para celebrar su cumpleaños en el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta y José son reprobadas por copiarse en un examen. Por su parte, Franco cancela la fiesta de cumpleaños de Mía por la broma que le hizo a Valeria. Además, Vico le aconseja a Giovanni que deje de actuar.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía encuentra a Miguel en su closet. Por otro lado, Diego le dice a Roberta que le molesta verla con Facundo y la besa apasionadamente. Luego, Angelita cita a Miguel para contarle sobre su sobrino Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón sorprende a Miguel investigando todo sobre él y le pone una trampa. Mientras tanto, Roberta le reclama a su mamá por organizar la fiesta de Mía. Diego se queda sin frenos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni y Vico se quedan encerrados en la cafetería toda la noche. Mientras tanto, Diego destruye el coche de Simón. Luego, Diego inventa que perdió la memoria y que no recuerda a Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego le regala flores y le roba un beso a Roberta, y ella queda encantada con el cambio de él. Por su lado, Alma propone que Mía y Roberta celebren su cumpleaños juntas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le dice a Diego que sí quiere ser su novia. Por su parte, el premio a la reina de la noche lo gana la persona menos esperada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma organiza la fiesta de cumpleaños de Mía y Roberta. Pero Roberta y Diego son secuestrados por León. Además, Mía y Miguel descubren a qué se dedica Gastón en su tiempo libre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni se reincorpora a la escuela. Por su parte, la banda va a tocar a un café y Tomás se echa un palomazo con otro grupo. Además, Teo y José se besan.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía cena con su padre y Valeria, quién tiene un plan para arruinar su fiesta. Alma descubre que Roberta y Diego son novios. Vico visita a la mamá de Giovanni. Celina cree que Simón siente algo por ella.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía no quiere irse de viaje en su cumpleaños con su papá. Franco le prohíbe a Mía seguir viendo a Alma, pues es mala influencia. Pilar amenaza a Diego con decirle de la apuesta a Roberta si no le ayuda a ser novia de Tomás.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Simón es el nuevo fotógrafo de la escuela, se enamora de Roberta. Por su parte, José se entera de que su tutor también vivía en la calle.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta se va con el fotógrafo y Diego se pone celoso. Tomás le dice a Roberta que Diego apostó con él, ella se pone muy triste. Además, Miguel planea descubrir a Gastón.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón le miente a Franco y le dice que no está saliendo con Mía. Simón sigue a Roberta hasta su casa de campo. Giovanni le pide perdón a Vico. Pascual les informa a los alumnos que Giovanni fue aceptado nuevamente en el colegio.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Giovanni presenta a sus padres frente a todos sus compañeros y les pide disculpas por negarlos. Por su parte, Roberta tiene un accidente en una motocicleta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Simón trata de convencer a Roberta para que regrese al colegio. Lupita le dice a Mía que terminando el año escolar Miguel se regresa a Monterrey. Franco acepta que Mía y Alma sean amigas.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Franco le pide ayuda a Miguel para separar a Mía y Gastón. Mía se molesta al enterarse de que Miguel trabajará con su padre.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar trata de golpear a Lupita por decirle a su madre que ella robó los exámenes y Luján la defiende. Celina borra a Lupita de la lista de invitados al cumpleaños de Mía como venganza por decir que Pilar se robó los exámenes.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón le asegura a Mía que se vengará de Miguel. Diego le confiesa a Roberta que sigue enamorado de ella y la besa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Jacobo dice que RBD no podrá seguir tocando en el café, ellos se molestan, pero saben que no pueden hacer nada. Mía encuentra una extraña carta dirigida a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Roberta se enteran de que sus papás se encargarán de organizar su fiesta. Por su parte, Simón le dice a Roberta que hará publicidad para que la banda RBD de un concierto en un teatro.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel y Mía confrontan a Celina y ella confiesa que escribió la carta influenciada por Pilar y le pide perdón a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego no quiere que su papá vea la propaganda de RBD. Mientras tanto, José recibe un regalo de su tutor. Roberta entierra el vestido que usaría Mía en su fiesta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta está muy preocupada porque destruyó el vestido de Mía por las razones equivocadas. A pesar de su arrepentimiento, Mía se entera y casi la mata.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le pide una disculpa a Mía por haberle tirado su vestido, pero Mía no piensa discutir más ahora que llegó el día de su fiesta. Por otro lado, Alma le regala a Roberta una moto.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Marcelino le dice a Roberta que su hermano lo obligaba a robar. Pilar le explica a Enrique que planeaba arruinar la fiesta de Mía y Roberta porque no la invitaron. Franco descubre que Alma encerró a Valeria. Peter abandona a Valeria en una calle.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta acepta ser novia de Simón. Mía le agradece a Roberta que le haya regalado su vestido. Roberta le dice a Mía que se le nota que adora a Miguel. RBD canta en la fiesta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía finge estar ebria y besa a Miguel. Peter renuncia antes de que lo corra Franco por Valeria. Diego le confiesa a Tomás estar enamorado de Roberta. Gastón se enfurece porque Mía termina con él. Alma le dice a Valeria que fue muy cruel con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón amenaza a Miguel con revelar su venganza en contra de Franco y Mía. Simón y Diego tienen un enfrentamiento por Roberta. Miguel le exige a Mía que le diga a Gastón que no son nada. Peter le dice a Mía que fue él quien le envió la carta.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Peter le dice a Mía que la carta que recibió fue escrita por su mamá hace varios años. Franco se enoja porque Mía decide irse a vivir con Alma. Roberta piensa vivir con Franco si Mía vive en su casa. Alma y Franco discuten por Peter.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta acusa a Pilar de mentirosa. Roberta y Alma discuten por Mía. León necesita el lugar donde tocará RBD para su campaña. Gastón le dice a Mía que Miguel quiere vengarse de su papá porque cree que es responsable de la muerte de su padre.

When Lizzy learns the unfortunate news that the ranch is about to be foreclosed; she devises a plan that will not only save her grandmother's property but also help Hope in the process.

programme.title: A Crafty Christmas Romance

In the book is a letter to Santa from 70 years ago and a valuable coin. Mandy sets out to find the owner of the book, letter and coin with the help of Jonah, a contractor who first came upon and donated the book. Along the way, they find clues that lead them closer to the author, and to each other, but can Mandy return everything to the book owner in time f

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Charlotte's taking her chance in the big city. She just began working for the hottest romance site writing their hit weekly dating article, and her new best friend, Lila, is as fun as she is loyal. She also befriends a coffee barista, Liam, who shows her all the best spots in the city. But dating a new guy each week to write about is making her feel burned out. And when Liam develops feelings for her, Charlotte will need to decide whether her work is more important than her chance at love.

programme.title: Midway to Love
programme.desc: When the network announces that her television therapy show is changing to a tabloid shock-fest, a straight laced and caring psychologist returns to her hometown and reunites with her high school sweetheart while finally realizing that having someone to share a life with is more important than fame and the excitement of the city.

Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life - a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Asia Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Eight billion people. Three billion living in cities. Over one billion tonnes of solid waste generated every year. This documentary moves between the anatomy of ecological catastrophe and the intelligence of those who have chosen to reverse it. From landfill wastelands to pioneering circular-economy projects, Rebellious Waste is a chronicle of excess and ingenuity - a film about what humanity discards, and what it might, with courage, reclaim.

programme.title: Asia Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Glass-floored catwalks suspended above canyons and open ocean. Telecom towers offering 360-degree panoramas over coastlines and cities. From Croatia to Malaysia, this film follows the vertiginous geography of human audacity - the places where engineering and exposure converge to produce an experience both architectural and intensely physical. A journey defined by altitude, adrenaline, and the extraordinary view from above.

programme.title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Gang violence breaks out when a long-simmering feud boils over; caught in the middle of the conflict is a young inmate, and jail staff responds with an all-out search for weapons.

programme.title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
programme.desc: California State Prison, Corcoran is a turbulent sea of politics: from old school prison gangs to disruptive street gangs, it's a dangerous mix for staff and inmates; known gang members are sent to security housing units to control their activity.

programme.title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Prison is a lonely place for any inmate; relationships that existed on the outside become strained and the ones that blossom within the prison walls are often dangerous; or they can be simply a one-sided obsession, leading to nothing but trouble.

programme.title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Violence often seems inevitable in prison; whether it stems from racial tension, or a dispute between cellmates, it's the job of Corcoran's officers to prevent attacks; in doing so, however, they put their own lives on the line.

programme.title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
programme.desc: The communities in Fairfax County, Virginia, have become some of the wealthiest and fastest growing in the nation, due in part to low crime rates, and, as one deputy says, taking care of the "little things" so "you don't have the big things."

programme.title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Burnout is a constant problem and unexcused absences create staff shortages at Alabama's Holman Correctional Facility; that means that designated jobs, like cell searches, which each shift has a requirement to perform, don't always get done.

As he draws close to uncovering his true identity, Nathan becomes the target of assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen (Lily Collins), the only person he can now trust.

When a riot results in his expulsion from Rome, Coriolanus seeks out his sworn enemy, Tullus Aufidius (Gerard Butler). Together, the pair vow to destroy the great city.

Since Adam is neither human nor demon, gargoyle Queen Leonore and demon Prince Naberius each want him for their own purposes. programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep, along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor.

programme.title: The Mummy's Curse
programme.desc: A mummy (Lon Chaney Jr.) and his princess (Virginia Christine) roam the Louisiana bayou.

programme.title: The Mummy's Ghost
programme.desc: A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

programme.title: The Mummy's Hand
programme.desc: In Cairo, archaeologist Steve Banning (Dick Foran) unearths a vase that he believes could lead him to the ancient tomb of Princess Ananka. Unknown to Steve, his colleague, Professor Andoheb (George Zucco), is also the High Priest of Karnak who holds the secrets of Karas, a mummy who guards Ananka's tomb. Upon receiving funds from magician Solvani (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Marta (Peggy Moran), Steve and the Solvanis embark on an expedition to the grave site, where Karas awaits.

programme.title: The Mummy's Tomb
programme.desc: Old archaeologist (Dick Foran) recalls mummy (Lon Chaney) at large in New England.

programme.title: Night Creatures
programme.desc: Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.

programme.title: Night Monster
programme.desc: A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.

programme.title: The Night Walker
programme.desc: A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Revenge of the Creature
programme.desc: Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.

programme.title: She-Wolf of London
programme.desc: Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.

programme.title: Son of Dracula
programme.desc: Count Alucard (Lon Chaney) makes Southern belle (Louise Allbritton) his bride.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: Tarantula
programme.desc: Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: When plans for a weekend vacation hit a dead end, friends find themselves stranded in unfamiliar territory, pursued by a bloodthirsty predator. Holed up in an isolated cabin, the friends must fight to survive as the body count rises.

programme.title: The Atticus Institute

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Kin

When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: Latency
programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Helicopter pilot Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) is part of a top-secret military operation that enables him to experience the last few minutes in the life of Sean Fentress, a man who died in a commuter-train explosion. The purpose of Colter's mission is to learn the identity of the bomber and prevent a similar catastrophe. programme.desc: Dos hermanos, uno compositor y el otro cantante, van a probar fama y fortuna a la capital.

programme.title: La hora del jaguar
programme.desc: Como agente de la policía se caracterizó por ser el más despiadado, ahora retirado, se convierte en asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: La hija sin padre
programme.desc: Una joven cantante se enamora de un hombre y se casa, pero este niega ser el padre de la criatura que ella espera.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: El rey de los albures
programme.desc: Un vendedor de tacos famoso por sus chistes participa en un concurso de baile con su ahijada para poder pagar una deuda.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Escape Sangriento
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de sus cómplices, un narcotraficante planea un peligroso escape de prisión.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: El hombre del puente
programme.desc: La odisea del expresidiario de un país dictatorial que queda inmovilizado por falta de papeles en un puente fronterizo.

programme.title: Asesino del Metro
programme.desc: El miedo se impone sobre la Ciudad de México, cuando un asesino a sus víctimas, todas mujeres, en el metro de la ciudad.

programme.title: El Pichichi del Barrio
programme.desc: El Pichichi es el entrenador de un equipo de fútbol femenino patrocinado por un narcotraficante ambicioso.

programme.title: El rey de los albures
programme.desc: Un vendedor de tacos famoso por sus chistes participa en un concurso de baile con su ahijada para poder pagar una deuda.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. programme.desc: Cada episodio de Torchlighters presenta la historia de un héroe de la vida real de la historia cristiana. Los niños verán lo que Dios puede hacer a través de un \"encendedor de antorchas\" y serán desafiados a llevar su propia antorcha mientras aprenden sob.

programme.title: Adoración en casa
programme.desc: Transforme la atmósfera de lo que sea que esté enfrentando a través del poder de la adoración con Josh Morales.

programme.title: Fe y Fuego
programme.desc: El Señor planta sueños en nuestro corazón, y estos pueden florecer cuando el suelo es fértil. Pongamos la mirada en lo que está delante y preparemos nuestra alma para alcanzar nueva esperanza, nuevas metas y cumplir sus sueños en nosotros.

programme.title: En Familia con Luis y Kristen

programme.title: A Toda Luz
programme.desc: ¿Te hace falta ánimo o quieres crecer en tu fe junto a otros? A Toda Luz es un programa lleno de vida, con conversaciones reales, risas, y verdades que inspiran. Con voces dinámicas y temas relevantes, te anima, te conecta y te acerca más a Dios.

programme.title: Dr. Robert Jeffries - Camino a la Victoria
programme.desc: Pastor de la Primera Iglesia Bautista de Dallas, Texas, y autor, el Dr. Robert Jeffress, ofrece a los espectadores y feligreses una colección de aplicaciones prácticas e inspiradoras derivadas de las Sagradas Escrituras para la sociedad actual.

programme.title: Lo sobrenatural ahora
programme.desc: El Apóstol Guillermo Maldonado demuestra el extraordinario poder de Dios y los milagros imposibles.

programme.title: Aqua viva con Sergio Hornung
programme.desc: Aqua Viva presenta al Pastor Sergio Hornung cada semana compartiendo un mensaje cargado de fe, vision y herramientas practicas, a fin de experimentar una genuina transformación por el poder del Espíritu Santo.

programme.title: En contacto con Dr. Charles Stanley
programme.desc: Pastor Dr. Charles Stanley usa sus diversos programas y ministerio para difundir el Evangelio a la población del mundo, y utiliza sus predicaciones para convencer a los seguidores del cristianismo a mantener una relación más estrecha con Jesucristo.

programme.title: Christian Worship Hour
programme.desc: La Hora de Adoración Cristiana con el Dr. Harold E. Salem proclama la Palabra de Dios con sencillez y humildad en toda su verdad y pureza, con especial preocupación y compasión por los perdidos y con esperanza y ánimo por todos los creyentes.

programme.title: Jentezen Franklin

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon and Carla Hall discuss the realities of cooking for picky eaters and busy families before welcoming New York Times bestselling author Caroline Chambers. Chambers shares her philosophy on deconstructing recipes to accommodate different preferences while keeping meals simple. She demonstrates her Lasagna-Vibes Turkey Zucchini Skillet, a 15-30 minute one-pan dinner featuring ground turkey, zucchini, ricotta, and mozzarella that delivers lasagna flavors without the complexity. The episode explores ingredient swaps, store-bought shortcuts, and how to get nutritious food on the table quickly when time is limited.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon celebrate anchovies in this episode of Chewed Up Show, tackling the misconception that many people dislike the ingredient. Michael Symon shares his inspiration for the featured dish—Stuffed Celery with Anchovies and Mascarpone—drawing from memories of Zuni Cafe in San Francisco and childhood celery boats. The hosts prepare the recipe on camera, combining mascarpone, crème fraîche, olives, garlic, and lemon zest as a base, then top with quality anchovies, Aleppo pepper, Parmesan, and fresh celery leaves. Throughout the episode, the hosts discuss ingredient preferences, play a humorous game pairing foods with musicians, and answer fan mail about cooking challenges and cheese pairings.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: The Chewed Up Show team declares cookie season and welcomes legendary pastry chef Jacques Torres, known as Mr. Chocolate, to share his expertise. Torres demonstrates how to make Chocolate Pecan Flourless Cookies, a gluten-free treat that's crispy on the outside and fudgy inside. The episode explores Torres's 52-year career in pastry and chocolate, his time as pastry chef at Le Cirque from 1989 to 2000, and his philosophy on cookie texture and ingredients. The hosts discuss dunking cookies in red wine, the importance of quality vanilla and dark chocolate, and tips for keeping cookie dough in the freezer for fresh-baked treats on demand.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In the debut episode of Simply Symons, Michael Symon welcomes viewers into his Venice, California front yard alongside his wife Liz Symon and their friend Olivia Annacone Cisic for an unfiltered, laid-back cookout. Celebrating Cinco de Mayo, Michael prepares simple yet flavorful black cod fish tacos on a plancha, walking through his approach to seasoning, cooking fish by sight, and building a bright, crunchy slaw with cabbage, citrus, and charred poblanos. The conversation flows easily as the trio shares cooking tips, debates ingredients like corn versus flour tortillas, and jokes about knife sharpening habits, cilantro preferences, and home cooking realities. Liz complements the meal with a refreshing jalapeño margarita, balancing heat with fresh lime juice, simple syrup, and a hint of orange liqueur, while adding her own creative twist with lemon and bitters. Throughout the episode, the group emphasizes flexibility in cooking—encouraging viewers to adjust flavors, garnishes, and spice levels to their own tastes. Lighthearted banter continues as they assemble tacos, discuss plating ideas, and highlight optional additions like crema and avocado. The episode wraps with a taste test, enthusiastic reactions to both the tacos and cocktail, and a reminder that great food doesn’t have to be complicated—just fresh, simple, and made with joy.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Olivia Annacone Cisic tackle a brunch-inspired twist on eggs Benedict by swapping traditional Canadian bacon for crispy pastrami and pairing it with a mustard-spiked hollandaise sauce. Michael walks through a foolproof blender hollandaise method while explaining the science behind emulsifying butter and keeping the sauce warm, making the intimidating brunch staple feel approachable for home cooks. As the family cooks together, the conversation bounces between Olivia’s skepticism about poached eggs, Liz’s love of runny yolks, and memories of iconic pastrami spots like Langer’s and Katz’s. The group also debates poaching techniques, from classic whirlpool methods to muffin tin hacks for feeding a crowd. Humor carries the episode throughout as Michael teases Olivia’s picky eating habits and the family jokes about “buttering muffins” and hollandaise disasters. Liz complements the rich brunch dish with a citrus-forward mimosa made from blood oranges, sumo oranges, lemon juice, and frozen strawberries used as flavorful ice cubes. Once plated, the pastrami Benedict wins Olivia over completely, with the crispy pastrami and tangy mustard hollandaise becoming the standout combination. The episode wraps with the family enjoying brunch cocktails, discussing make-ahead egg tips, and Michael reminding viewers that restaurant-quality brunch can come together quickly and simply at home.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon kicks off a new era of Simply Symons from Venice, California, joined by Liz Symon and Olivia “Liv” Annacone Cisic for a laid-back backyard cookout centered around the ultimate burger debate: smash burgers versus classic pub burgers. Michael walks through the techniques behind each style, from selecting the ideal fat ratio for ground beef to achieving the perfect crust on a hot grill and cast iron griddle. Along the way, the trio shares stories about old Symon’s Dinners episodes, Liv’s transition into motherhood, and the realities of filming outdoors with planes overhead, lawn equipment buzzing nearby, and neighborhood life unfolding around them. As Michael builds both burgers with grilled onions, pickles, secret sauce, and different cheeses, the conversation turns into a humorous discussion about condiments, cooking preferences, smash burger myths, and burger nostalgia. Liz keeps the energy going with playful jabs at Michael while also preparing his favorite cocktail, the bourbon-based Paper Plane, complete with Aperol, Amaro, and fresh lemon juice. The episode wraps with a tasting session comparing both burgers side-by-side, with everyone weighing in on which version wins the battle. Between the casual banter, cooking tips, and family-style atmosphere, the episode delivers an easygoing and highly approachable backyard burger feast.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In this Memorial Day-themed episode of Simply Symons, Michael Symon cooks outdoors with his wife Liz and co-host Olivia Annacone Cisic, preparing grilled shrimp skewers with a honey-soy-orange glaze, a pineapple salsa, and a coconut rice pilaf, while Liz mixes up a frothy pineapple daiquiri with an egg-white twist. The episode opens with playful banter about Olivia's discovery of gray hairs at 33, her upcoming bachelorette party plans, and Michael's gentle ribbing of the trio's early-dinner, early-bedtime lifestyle. Michael walks through his Memorial Day menu, highlighting a coconut rice made with jasmine rice, coconut milk, and a coconut curry lime bone broth from friend Marco Canora's brand Brodo, plus a bright pineapple salsa built with cilantro, scallion, red pepper, jalapeño, honey, and a dashi soy sauce sourced from Santa Monica's McCall's butcher. A lively debate breaks out over rice ratios and rinsing technique, with Liz advocating for a 1:1¾ ratio while Michael sticks to his two-to-one method, and Olivia sharing that she recently cooked jasmine rice for her unwell dog Zeke. Throughout the cooking session, mishaps and humor keep things lively — limes refuse to juice, Liz nearly topples the dashi bottle, and Michael accidentally steps on their dog Min. Discussions range from shrimp varieties and sizing (the U-number system), to the fruity heat of jalapeños and habaneros, to favorite hot sauces including Crystal and the Florida datil-pepper-based Zabs. Liz's honest palate becomes a recurring theme, with Michael crediting her direct, critical feedback as a key ingredient in his culinary success over the years. Liz dry-shakes her egg-white pineapple daiquiri before adding ice for a frothy finish, then adjusts the balance mid-tasting by swirling in extra pineapple juice. The shrimp grill up with beautiful caramelization from the honey glaze, and the coconut rice is finished simply with cilantro and cracked black pepper. During the final tasting, Olivia — a self-described texture-averse pasta lover — bravely tries the shrimp, endorsing the flavors while admitting she prefers the coconut rice. Michael closes the episode wishing viewers a happy Memorial Day and reminding them to keep things simple and delicious.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon grills a spatchcock chicken with avgolemono sauce in his Venice Beach front yard, joined by his wife Liz and co-host Liv. The episode features a lavender lemon drop martini and explores grill techniques for perfectly crispy, juicy poultry.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In this Simply Symons episode, hosts Michael and Liz Symon, alongside Liv Annacone, prepare a summer-inspired dish featuring seared halloumi cheese topped with warm strawberries, fresh mint, pistachios, and a red wine vinaigrette infused with honey and cracked black pepper. Liz creates a homemade strawberry simple syrup using fresh and frozen strawberries, which becomes the base for a refreshing strawberry vodka martini garnished with mint. The hosts discuss the unique properties of halloumi—a Cypriot cheese that doesn't melt and develops a savory crust when seared—and explore the classic pairing of sweet and salty flavors. They also share storage tips for fresh herbs and berries, mention the superior quality of local Harry's berries, and discuss favorite summer TV shows.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In this episode of Simply Symons, hosts Michael Symon and Liz Symon, joined by Liv Annacone, bring the show indoors to cook during warm weather. Michael creates an elevated crab grilled cheese sandwich using mascarpone, jumbo lump crab meat, Old Bay seasoning, tarragon mustard, and pickled red onions, with parmigiano-reggiano crust for extra crispness. Meanwhile, Liz prepares an orange whip cocktail with a modern twist, substituting tangerine juice for traditional orange juice and combining vodka, rum, Grand Marnier, and heavy cream. The episode showcases kitchen techniques like gentle folding to preserve crab lumps and discusses alternative grilled cheese fillings, while celebrating nostalgic Cleveland dining memories and mall culture.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon demonstrates how to make Korean-style short ribs using a quick grilling method combined with a flavorful Asian pear-based marinade featuring soy, mirin, gojuchang, and sesame oil. The thin-cut ribs marinate for 6-12 hours to tenderize, then grill for just 3 minutes per side over high heat. Michael garnishes the finished ribs with crispy scallions, cilantro, a sesame-chili mix, and lime. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares a refreshing soju mojito by muddling fresh mint and lime, then adding soju, lime juice, and maple syrup for depth. Liv Annacone joins the hosts as they discuss the ease and flavor of both dishes.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: For the Fourth of July, Michael Symon showcases his approach to smoked ribs, starting with a custom cherry BBQ sauce made from cherry juice, sherry vinegar, molasses, bourbon, cold brew coffee, and warm spices. He explains his smoking technique at 300-325°F for two and a half hours, finishing the ribs on the grill for char and caramelization. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares a tart cherry Negroni—an equal-parts cocktail featuring gin, Campari, sweet vermouth, tart cherry juice, and a splash of seltzer. The episode balances savory and sweet as the hosts discuss rib texture preferences, ideal side dishes, and the versatility of the cherry sauce.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone welcome their Venice neighbor Rose Previte, chef and owner of the acclaimed Michelin-starred restaurant Maidan, to craft beef souvlaki kebabs with grilled pita and tzatziki. Rose shares her culinary journey and the spices that define Middle Eastern and Greek kebab traditions—from sumac and fresh mint to warming spices like cinnamon and Syrian seven-spice blend. The episode also features a wine pairing with rare Georgian amber wines from two female winemakers, including the endangered Del Shavi grape variety. Throughout, the hosts discuss Rose's innovative Maidan Market concept in Los Angeles and their shared Midwestern roots.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon, his wife Liz, and Liv Annacone cook Big Rigs rigatoni with spicy Italian sausage and vodka sauce in their front yard. Michael demonstrates his "cheater sauce" approach using pre-seasoned sausage, tomato paste, cream, and vodka that comes together in under 30 minutes without needing a knife. The hosts discuss pasta cooking techniques, the importance of finishing pasta in sauce rather than plating separately, proper seasoning of pasta water, and using quality ingredients like whole Parmigiano-Reggiano. They pair the dish with Lambrusco, an Italian sparkling red wine, exploring its versatility with various cuisines and its ability to cut through rich, spicy flavors.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane visits Laconia, where the famous Kalamata olive is cultivated, to follow the famous olive from harvest to table. After a chilly day of collecting, scoring, and processing the ripened fruits, Diane heads to the kitchen to whip up an olive feast. Find out how olives can transform any meal into a masterpiece.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane travels to her family's native island of Ikaria, where locals are 10 times more likely to live to one hundred than Americans. Diane's young 85-year-old neighbors share a lesson in making wild herb teas; a beekeeper reveals the honey that is one of the secrets to Ikarians' renowned longevity. Enjoy the deliciously simple and wonderfully healthy cuisine of Ikaria.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the ancient grains that Greek cooks still love to use. Learn how to incorporate timeless ancient grains into every meal of the day.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Emerald green Greek extra virgin olive oil is the star of this show. Diane takes us on a journey to the stunningly preserved town of Monemvasia. Explore the diversity and beauty of one of Greece's most delectable exports.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores the meze tradition of small plates of vibrant food meant to be shared. She uncovers the vast variety and robust flavors of the meze table and invites a wine expert into the kitchen for advice on what to pair when the meal includes spice, yogurt, cheese, crunch, comfort, seafood, meat and more, all in one sitting. Discover the fun and festive meze tradition.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Go on a picnic at a vineyard in Naoussa were one grape dominates the table: the local Xinomavro, one of Greece's noblest reds. On the wine trail, Diane discovers bread, cookies and chocolate truffles all spiked with this hard-to-pronounce but easy-to-love Greek varietal. Learn how to incorporate incomparable Greek wine into any menu, both as a drink and an ingredient.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane celebrates the intensely flavored food and unique wines of one of Greece's most breathtaking islands, Santorini. Diane hops in a boat to pick capers on this volcanic island. She visits a renowned vineyard which still practices the island tradition of growing grapes in basket-shaped vines. Enjoy the tastes of Santorini with ingredients from field to sea.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques suggests that mastering simple skills and techniques will make your life easier and when you’re comfortable in the kitchen, you’ll be more creative and avoid the trap of a quick fix with a frozen meal…or worse! He teaches you how to sharpen knives, cut and prepare vegetables and eggs and finally make a delicious gratin.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacues knows that most of us want to eat a healthy diet with lots of organic produce. Now so much is available at farmers markets and in grocery stores, you don’t have to spend a fortune if you chose what’s in season when it tastes the best. But for those times you’re in a hurry, it’s okay to grab prewashed, precut or frozen vegetables to make your life easier.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques shows that with a well-stocked pantry and a few good cooking techniques, you can make a tasty dish or a simple meal. His pantry essentials include potato flakes for a simple soup, spaghetti for a quick main dish, lentils, canned salmon, polenta and finally, in the freezer, a poundcake that can be transformed into a celebration dessert.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life’s greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father’s Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod––raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it’s time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home
