programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just beyond the Kaikoura Peninsula lies a dramatic, 1200-metre deep canyon supplying nutrient-rich food to a bevy of hungry animals above and underwater. The always-playful Dusky Dolphins, New Zealand Fur Seals, and Red-Billed Gulls take advantage of this bounty at an especially important time of year. It's breeding season, and thousands of Red-Billed Gulls form the largest colony in the South Island. Duskies mate, too, but for fun as well as reproduction. And a Fur Seal finds a magic place while his mother is out at sea.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's summer on New Zealand's Open Bay Islands, and the local population swells. Wily octopus, foraging crayfish and darting penguins are joined by over 4,000 New Zealand fur seals. Masterful divers, they successfully straddle two distinct neighborhoods: beneath the waves, where they play and eat – and these rocky outcrops, where they're born and mate. Mothers balance the demands of nursing pups, mating-keen males, and their own need to efficiently hunt and feed. Everyone here has new mouths to feed, including the scavenging Weka. Unable to fly nor swim, the species was introduced as food for sealers a century ago -- and has been marooned here ever since.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Stewart Island, New Zealand's third largest and southernmost island, is a place of dramatic beauty and unpredictability. Here, the Pot-bellied Seahorse father has extra responsibilities, the Octopus is both hunter and hunted, and 82 Great White Sharks need to eat, too. Standing at just 30cm and weighing only 1 kg, the Little Blue Penguin is nonetheless a swift swimmer and a determined parent.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode is about on the most ancient and majestic animal of the continent: the muskox seems like the last survivor of the ice age – and it is. Thousands of years ago the animals roamed our landscapes together with mammoths. Nowadays, the only remaining herds live in Scandinavia: the Dovrefjell National Park in Norway and the Härjedaalen area in Sweden - where scientists and environmentalists put up a breeding centre in order to protect and strengthen the wild population of muskox - are the main locations of this episode.

programme.title: Bucketlist Europe
programme.desc: Europe is a densely packed continent, with some 700 million residents living across 50 countries. It's famed for its ancient cities and civilisations, but is sometimes overlooked when it comes to the natural world. But there's no doubt that the continent is a treasure trove of natural beauty, a mosaic of landscapes each filled with their own unique animal communities. If you were planning a bucket list trip of the natural wonders of Europe, you'd only have to ask yourself one question: where would you start?

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Rivers and Lakes
programme.desc: Water is the beginning of all life - including the wildlife of Germany. Beavers fell trees, otters play under water, kingfishers catch fish for their young. Lakes and rivers cover just 2.5% of the total area of the country. The episode Rivers and Lakes takes the viewer on a journey through the water world of Germany. In winter, the few ice-free surfaces are popular with waterfowl. Coots throng the source ponds of the River Havel, while above them white-tailed eagles gather for the hunt, as their prey swim openly beneath them. The coots stick together, swimming to and fro to make it difficult for the eagles to pick out one individual bird. But with each attack, the coots grow increasingly tired. In Spring, the ice melts and the lakes and rivers awake from their winter torpor. Germany has more than 800 rivers longer than 10km. They transport the life-giving liquid into all corners of the country. The water of the River Danube alone would be enough to fill Germany's biggest body of water, Lake Constance, in 12 months. Every year, six times the volume of the lake falls in the form of precipitation: 800 litres per square metre. Otters and beavers had a very hard time in recent centuries. They were hunted mercilessly for their fur and eaten in periods of fasting. Today, both species are protected and their populations are recovering.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programme.desc: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch. Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere... Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower. Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: CRIME FILES

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature

programme.title: Miracles of Nature

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska. It's here where a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat these fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai

The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mom and her three cubs. They arrive at their destination and see many bears that they have already met as well as some new faces.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
programme.desc: Everyone hates biting insects, but if you look closer you can see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem. During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: This video delves into the passionate and tumultuous journey of a small-town romance, capturing the essence of youthful love and heartbreak. The Giant Pig Smokehouse, a beloved local barbecue spot, serves as a backdrop for heartfelt conversations between friends and patrons who share their thoughts on love, loss, and moving forward. Owners Melissa and her brother opened the establishment in 2019, inspired by their love for smoked foods and Southern barbecue traditions. The video showcases their dedication to serving flavorful, family-style meals, emphasizing the importance of patience and love in their cooking. Viewers will hear from various patrons, each with their own story of love and heartache. From a couple reminiscing about their high school days to a person reflecting on a past relationship, the narratives highlight the universal themes of longing, regret, and the hope for new beginnings. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is more than just a restaurant it's a community hub where stories unfold and lives intersect. Whether it's the long lines for their famous pulled pork or the creation of a special menu item due to a customer's misreading, the video paints a vivid picture of a place that nurtures connections and memories. Join us as we explore how love, in all its forms, shapes the experiences of those who walk through its doors.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: Un giovane torna nella sua città natale con la nuova fidanzata, scatenando la gelosia ossessiva della sua ex. Quella che sembra una visita innocente si trasforma in una spirale di violenza.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: Un tranquillo villaggio viene sconvolto da una maledizione antica che risveglia Crom, un'entità oscura assetata di vendetta. Un gruppo di giovani liceali unisce le forze per affrontare questa forza malefica e salvare la propria comunità. Una corsa contro il tempo tra misteri, paura e coraggio. Riusciranno a spezzare la maledizione?

programme.title: Hold your breath
programme.desc: Un'antica leggenda metropolitana narra che di fronte ai cimiteri, se non trattieni il respiro, gli spiriti maligni possano prendere il sopravvento. Quando sette amici trascorrono un fine settimana in campeggio, uno di loro decide di sfatare il mito, liberando però lo spirito di un noto serial killer. Inizia un massacro che non risparmierà quasi nessuno.

programme.title: UN BALLO PER NATALE
programme.desc: Olivia, la maestra di danza, seleziona Lily per il saggio di Natale. Ben presto, però, si trova a innamorarsi di Michael, il padre della ragazzina. La sua vita è a un bivio, seguire il cuore o tornare in Florida?

programme.title: UN NATALE IN VIGNA
programme.desc: Heather, conduttrice di “Read Between the Vines”, è determinata a creare il perfetto episodio natalizio presentando un'azienda vinicola unica della sua città natale. L'unica cosa che le ostacola il cammino? Rudy, l'affascinante e testardo proprietario dell'azienda vinicola.

programme.title: UN NATALE DA SCOPRIRE
programme.desc: Il Natale nella campagna inglese non era nei piani di Emma fino a quando sua sorella Amy non ha deciso di organizzare il suo matrimonio per la vigilia di Natale. Dylan, il socio di Amy nel mercatino di Natale, collabora con Emma per mettere ordine nel caos dei preparativi.

programme.title: LE 12 SFIDE PER NATALE
programme.desc: La tranquilla stagione festiva di un'insegnante subisce una scossa quando accetta la sfida delle 12 prove di Natale lanciata dalla sorella, mentre si affretta a preparare la sua città per un programma di scambio natalizio con un affabile e supponente insegnante di francese.

programme.title: UN NATALE VERO E SINCERO
programme.desc: Un magico desiderio natalizio dona a un organizzatore di eventi la capacità di ascoltare ciò che tutti desiderano per le festività.

programme.title: Un Natale di ricordi
programme.desc: All'avvicinarsi del Natale, Darcy e Aiden sono rattristati dall'imminente chiusura del centro ricreativo della loro comunità. Per salvare il loro amato centro, ma anche lo spirito natalizio, Darcy e Aiden si imbarcano in un magico percorso di amore e felicità.

programme.title: Ricordati di te
programme.desc: Tratto dal libro best seller. Darcy Archer è una ragazza romantica, che sogna di essere conquistata dall'uomo perfetto. Invece, un giorno, mentre si reca al lavoro in bicicletta, Darcy si scontra accidentalmente con uno sconosciuto bello e ben vestito che porta a spasso il cane.

programme.title: Broadcasting Christmas
programme.desc: Quando la sua partner di conduzione decide di lasciare lo show del mattino preferito dagli americani, Veronika Daniels annuncia che sceglierà il suo nuovo co-conduttore tra una rosa di candidati, tra i quali Charlie Fisher, un conduttore del notiziario locale di New York.

programme.title: Un magico Natale
programme.desc: Dopo un brutto incidente d'auto, Carrie Bishop si sveglia a Central Park, faccia a faccia con un angelo. L'angelo le dà la possibilità di cambiare la vita di un uomo d'affari in difficoltà e di guadagnarsi un posto in paradiso. Questo film è una storia di scoperta e del vero spirito del Natale.

programme.title: George Balanchine lo schiaccianoci
programme.desc: La vigilia di Natale, Clara vuole rimanere sveglia per giocare con la sua bambola Schiaccianoci, ma deve andare a letto. Quando tutti vanno in pensione, scende di nascosto al piano di sotto per stare con la sua bambola, si addormenta e sogna una magica avventura.

programme.title: Milano rovente
programme.desc: Salvatore Cangemi, proprietario di una società di ortofrutta di giorno e magnaccia di notte, viene minacciato dall'apparizione di uno spietato gangster francese chiamato Le Capitaine che vuole unire il crimine organizzato a Milano per ottenere tutti i profitti. Totò non ha intenzione di far parte dell'organizzazione di Le Capitaine, e la loro rivalità causa una sanguinosa guerra tra bande.

programme.title: Blue Water
programme.desc: Giulia è una giovane nuotatrice dilettante che, suo malgrado, deve qualificarsi per partecipare alle Olimpiadi. Di giorno lavora in un bar, di notte si allena in piscina. Ha poco tempo. Sua sorella maggiore Giuditta, campionessa di nuoto, ha perso la vista in seguito ad un incidente automobilistico: alla guida c'era Giulia.

programme.title: Giriamo un film a modo mio
programme.desc: Alberto è un giovane ambizioso che vuole realizzare un film. Mette insieme una banda sgangherata di amici e via con le riprese! Non tutto va come dovrebbe però: imprevisti, ritardi, capitomboli uno dietro l'altro. Riuscirà Alberto a realizzare il suo sogno e finalmente lanciare il suo film rivoluzionario?

programme.title: Il circo delle meraviglie
programme.desc: L'amore di Sofia Von Sydov, detta la Principessa Volante, erede di una grande famiglia circense, e Andrea Parodi, rampollo di un ricco imprenditore navale, alla ricerca della felicità e del proprio posto nel mondo.

programme.title: Italian Business
programme.desc: Tre episodi che ruotano intorno al tema dei finanziamenti promossi dall'Unione Europea. Il bagnino Walter, la ballerina Monica e l'albergatore Rino devono fare i conti con le trame oscure del commercialista Randazzi.

programme.title: L'automobile
programme.desc: Anna Mastronardi (Anna Magnani) è una matura ex-prostituta diventata un'istituzione per la vita notturna romana, tanto che si fa chiamare contessa. D'altro canto la donna si sente sola e senza scopi. Decide quindi di comprarsi un'automobile per trovare un nuovo interesse, per soddisfare il suo bisogno di sentirsi una donna realizzata e per mettersi in evidenza di fronte a tutta Via Veneto.

programme.title: Splendori e Miserie di Madame Royale
programme.desc: Alessio, ex ballerino e corniciaio, vive ai margini della società e protegge una giovane amica. Quando diventa informatore della polizia, il suo fragile equilibrio si spezza e amicizie e lealtà vengono messe alla prova.

programme.title: I complessi
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi, Nino Manfredi e Ugo Tognazzi in una divertente commedia composta da tre episodi. Un timido impiegato riesce a dichiarare le sue intenzioni sentimentali a una collega un alto funzionario cerca di far sparire le tracce di un filmato compromettente un partecipante a un concorso, dotato di una brutta dentatura, mette in crisi i tentativi di boicottaggio da parte della commissione.

programme.title: Totòtruffa '62
programme.desc: Antonio vive di truffe per mantenere la figlia all'oscuro della sua vera attività. Con il complice Camillo mette in scena raggiri sempre più improbabili, fino alla celebre vendita della Fontana di Trevi.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: The Old Man and The Gun
programme.desc: La storia vera della fuga dal carcere del settantenne Forrest Tucker, della successiva fuga dal detective Hunt e della sua storia d'amore.

programme.title: Spore
programme.desc: Due amiche disegnatrici di fumetti, uno stupro, un omicidio per vendetta, una fuga. Sullo sfondo gli anni Ottanta, quelli delle fanzine e del punk, del referendum contro il nucleare e di una provincia sempre troppo stretta.

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!
programme.desc: Val, governante devota, vede il suo equilibrio cambiare quando la figlia Jessica arriva con le sue ambizioni. Un film vincitore al Berlinale e al Sundance che esplora temi di classe e disuguaglianza, con un'interpretazione straordinaria di Regina Casé.

programme.title: Prima danza e poi pensa
programme.desc: Il film ci mostra le tappe fondamentali della vita del grande scrittore Samuel Beckett, dall'infanzia in Irlanda al periodo parigino.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Un professore di archeologia, Moriarty, per impossessarsi di antichi pezzi provenienti da scavi fatti in Egitto, organizza una banda criminale che si macchia dei più efferati delitti. Ma tutte le sue mosse sono scoperte da Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: Il cagnaccio dei Baskervilles
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes e l'assistente Watson vengono ingaggiati a indagare sugli omicidi della famiglia di nobili, i Baskerville, a cui appare un cane intento ad azzannare gli eredi.

programme.title: Guerra al virus
programme.desc: America anni '80. Il dottor Francis è uno dei primi a scoprire il virus dell'Hiv, ma la società americana rimane indifferente alla malattia considerandola pericolosa solo per gli omosessuali.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare esistenza.

programme.title: Dylan Dog
programme.desc: Deciso a lasciare mostri e non morti al loro mondo, l'indagatore dell'incubo Dylan Dog viene richiamato suo malgrado in servizio dalla bionda Elizabeth, per far luce sulla misteriosa morte di suo padre.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite, instillando l'amore, la sensibilità e la paura in chi ne viene colpito. In tale contesto, i giovani Nia e Silas vivranno sulla loro pelle i dilemmi generati da una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: A Parigi, Grace e le sue amiche sono in un albergo di lusso, quando una di loro viene scambiata per una ricca ereditiera. Neanche il tempo di chiarire, che già sono verso Monte Carlo…

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Violet, sedici anni, sogna di fare la cantante e vive sola con sua madre che ha difficoltà ad arrivare a fine mese. Quando scopre che sono aperte le audizioni per il talent show Teen Spirit, partecipa nella speranza che sia il punto di partenza per la sua carriera di cantante.

programme.title: Il Nido dei Calabroni
programme.desc: Un serial killer terrorizza Charlotte, nella Carolina del Nord. Spetterà al capo della polizia Judy Hammer e alla sua vice, Virginia West, scoprire il colpevole prima che colpisca di nuovo.

programme.title: Hard night falling
programme.desc: Durante una cena nella lussuosa villa della famiglia Rossini, il criminale Goro e la sua banda prendono in ostaggio gli invitati per rubare un'ingente quantità d'oro. Ignorano però che tra gli ospiti c'è Michael Anderson (Dolph Lundgren), un agente dell'Interpol altamente addestrato, determinato a salvare la sua famiglia e sventare il colpo.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: Christian è un ventenne ricco, prepotente e manipolatore. La fidanzata Tara è, invece, una ex modella che pur di stare con Christian calpesta propria dignità. Le loro vite saranno cambiate da un incontro sessuale che li condurrà in un percorso di violenza, inganni e paranoia.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Come salvare il Natale
programme.desc: Megan dedica il periodo natalizio ad aiutare gli altri. Quando deve salvare una festa cittadina, si ritrova divisa tra l'uomo dei suoi sogni e quello che potrebbe essere davvero giusto per lei.

programme.title: Natale per sempre
programme.desc: Una produttrice televisiva prepara un reality su un uomo che celebra Natale ogni giorno dell'anno, ma il progetto professionale si trasforma presto in un sentimento autentico.

programme.title: L'ultimo regalo
programme.desc: Un giovane viziato scopre che per ottenere l'eredità del nonno dovrà affrontare una serie di prove capaci di insegnargli ciò che conta davvero nella vita.

programme.title: Natale tra i monti Blue Ridge
programme.desc: Una donna torna nella sua città natale per aiutare a organizzare un matrimonio natalizio e si riavvicina a un amore del passato tra le montagne Blue Ridge.

programme.title: Un amore sotto i riflettori
programme.desc: Avery ha un segreto nascosto: diventare una stilista e lavorare per Lisette Monique. Oliver, un ragazzo del upper east side, offre ad Avery la possibilità di lavorare per Lisette in cambio di un appuntamento pubblico con lui per riabilitare la sua immagine da bad boy.

programme.title: C'era una volta a Shaw Bay
programme.desc: Quando la città costiera di Shaw Bay è minacciata da un riqualificazione, l'agente immobiliare Erin farà di tutto per salvarla. Entra in scena il bel Theo, un reale in cerca di una nuova proprietà. Il trucco è che sta nascondendo la parte reale.

programme.title: Intrecci pericolosi
programme.desc: Le gemelle Reina e Alex vedono le loro vite sconvolte dall'arrivo dell'enigmatica sorella trigemina Trinity, separata da loro alla nascita e decisa a incastrarne una per omicidio e a prendere l'identità dell'altra.

programme.title: Un legame fatale
programme.desc: Dopo un incidente d'auto che lascia il suo fidanzato Patrick in coma, la graphic designer April inizia a soffrire di attacchi di panico. Ma il suo nuovo amico nasconde forse un secondo fine?

programme.title: Crash Site
programme.desc: Un incidente con una Jeep invia una coppia in vacanza in un inquietante viaggio di ritorno verso la sicurezza.

programme.title: Cruise
programme.desc: Estate 1987. Gio, un ragazzo italiano del Queens, pensa solamente alle automobili e alle ragazze. Crede di aver capito tutto fino a quando non incontra Jessica, una graziosa ragazza ebrea di Long Island a cui piace provare emozioni proibite.

programme.title: Un amore da ricordare
programme.desc: Dopo un anno di relazioni esclusivamente online, Tenley, un'orticoltrice attenta all'ambiente, trova finalmente il coraggio di incontrare Jared, il suo innamorato virtuale. Quando Jared non si presenta a causa di un incidente in bicicletta, in ospedale Tenley viene scambiata per sua moglie.

programme.title: Cercasi fidanzato per la vacanza
programme.desc: Amy ha pianificato una vacanza perfetta per l'anniversario con il fidanzato, che però decide di interrompere la relazione. Su consiglio degli amici, decide di trovare qualcuno che abbia lo stesso.

programme.title: Destinazione Matrimonio
programme.desc: Due perfetti sconosciuti si incontrano a un matrimonio in un'isola tropicale: lei è la testimone della sposa, lui il miglior amico dello sposo. Tra brindisi, gaffe e balli sotto le stelle, la loro iniziale antipatia si trasforma lentamente in qualcosa di più…

programme.title: Premonition
programme.desc: La vita di Linda viene sconvolta da una terribile notizia: suo marito è morto in un incidente stradale. La mattina dopo però Linda si risveglia trovando suo marito vivo e vegeto accanto a lei. Le giornate si susseguono senza più un apparente ordine temporale e Linda è sull'orlo della follia…

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone è il numero uno dei controllori del traffico aereo, finché un tranquillo sconosciuto, Russell Bell, non viene trasferito nel dipartimento. La rivalità tra i due migliori controllori del traffico aereo del TRACON di New York sale a un livello potenzialmente pericoloso.

programme.title: W.
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Oliver Stone tratteggia la dissacrante biografia dell'uomo più potente del mondo per ben otto anni: George W. Bush, amato e odiato, una delle figure più controverse della storia americana dei nostri tempi.

programme.title: Sono affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Vito (Dustin Hoffman) vive con il padre Jessie (Sean Connery) e il figlio Adam (Matthew Broderick). Insieme gestiscono un commercio all'ingrosso di carni.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere di una rubrica di consigli sull'amore speciale ma anonima. Mentre è lì, incontra il redattore capo, Morgan Cooper. Presto scoppieranno scintille tra di loro. Audrey sarà la protagonista della sua storia d'amore?

programme.title: Come ti organizzo il Natale
programme.desc: Conosciuto come un "risollevatore" per clienti difficili, un talentuoso organizzatore di feste deve aiutare un giovane amministratore delegato a organizzare la festa di Natale dell'anno per stupire il sindaco e salvare la sua azienda. Il "fixer" risolverà qualcosa di più della semplice azienda?

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: La stacanovista Jillian vuole vendere una baita di montagna, ma il bel custode Liam le fa un'offerta. Volano scintille quando trasformano la baita in un resort. Ma quando gli affari non vanno secondo i piani, Jillian rinuncerà a tutto per amore?

programme.title: The Fighters
programme.desc: Tra i suoi amici e l'azienda di famiglia, l'estate di Arnaud sembra destinata a essere tranquilla. Tranquilla fino a quando non incontra Madeleine, bella quanto brusca, una solida massa di muscoli tesi e profezie apocalittiche.

programme.title: La perla del paradiso
programme.desc: Una fotografa naturalista in cerca di avventure e un timoroso scrittore di romanzi si ritrovano alle Fiji, coinvolti in una caccia ad una rara perla blu.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: Passioni e Desideri
programme.desc: Con un grande cast, girato tra Vienna, Londra, Parigi, New York, l'Arizona e Rio de Janeiro, il film racconta quanti incontri, opportunità, scelte e decisioni ci si presentano nel corso di una vita.

programme.title: Papi Chulo
programme.desc: A Los Angeles, un solitario e alienato meteorologo televisivo "assume" un migrante latinoamericano di mezza età per essere suo amico.

programme.title: Mrs. Mills
programme.desc: Helene possiede un appartamento chic nel centro di Parigi, pubblica romanzi romanticamente kitsch e conduce una vita completamente dettata dal lavoro. Tutto il suo amore è per i libri. Ma la sua vita quotidiana viene stravolta quando la signora Mills, un'eccentrica signora americana, si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto.

programme.title: La Comune
programme.desc: Erik e Anna, con la figlia Freja, creano una comune nella villa di famiglia a Copenhagen. Tra amicizie, feste e sogni condivisi, l'equilibrio viene spezzato da una relazione inaspettata che metterà alla prova il legame tra i membri della comunità.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del vulcano
programme.desc: Per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo l'eruzione del vulcano Eyjafjallajökull è un duro colpo. Per Alain e Valerie è un disastro. Per poter arrivare nel piccolo villaggio della Grecia per il matrimonio della loro figlia, questa coppia di divorziati, che nutre un odio reciproco senza limiti, sarà costretta a intraprendere il viaggio insieme.

programme.title: Jack Et Jill
programme.desc: Jack Sadekstein, un uomo che abita fuori Los Angeles con la sua famiglia, deve vedersela con la sorella gemella Jill, che vive nel Bronx, che va a trovarlo per la festa del Ringraziamento ma rifiuta di tornarsene a casa dopo la festa.

programme.title: Io, Lei E I Suoi Bambini
programme.desc: Ice Cube è Nick, un playboy incallito che tenta di conquistare una giovane e bella divorziata, Suzanne (Nia Long).

programme.title: Finalmente A Casa
programme.desc: Finalmente a casa è il sequel della commedia del 2005 'Io, lei e i suoi bambini' e la storia riprende da dove era stata lasciata. Nick Persons (Ice Cube), ora sposato con Suzanne (Nia Long), ha comprato una casa in periferia per sfuggire alla vita frenetica della città e avere più spazio per la moglie e i figli Lindsey e Kevin (Aleisha Allen e Philip Daniel Bolden).

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Liberamente ispirato alla striscia di fumetti Little Orphan Annie, il film racconta la storia di un'orfanella che viene ospitata per una settimana nella villa di un ricco possidente che successivamente propone all'orfanotrofio che ospita la piccola di adottarla. La direttrice dell'istituto si opporrà però con tutte le sue forze all'adozione della piccola Annie.

programme.title: Il fidanzamento
programme.desc: La madre di Mirella vuole che Luigi sposi sua figlia, ma lui non vuole rinunciare al ruolo di fidanzato.

programme.title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
programme.desc: Due portieri siciliani fermano il piano di Goldfoot per scatenare una guerra, ma finiscono prigionieri in Siberia

programme.title: Riuscirà l'avvocato Franco Benenato a sconfiggere il suo acerrimo nemico il pretore Ciccio De Ingras?
programme.desc: Il pretore Ciccio, stanco dell'avv. Benenato, dopo il trasferimento di questi, si sente meglio finché a Milano non trova una sorpresa

programme.title: Scusi ma lei le paga le tasse
programme.desc: Un funzionario cade in disgrazia per colpa del nipote, che poi gli soffia la promozione.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: La coppia dei campioni
programme.desc: Due dipendenti della stessa multinazionale vincono alla lotteria aziendale un paio di biglietti per la finale della Champions League. Uno milanese, l'altro romano, uno benestante e l'altro nullatenente si conoscono per la prima volta all'imbarco per Praga detestandosi a prima vista.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: 1880.Sara (Salma Hayek), figlia di un ricco banchiere e Maria (Penelope Cruz), figlia di contadini, avevano pochissime possibilità di incontrasi e dividere la stessa sorte.

programme.title: Suocero scatenato
programme.desc: Un padre, maniaco del lavoro, spera di poter incontrare la figlia durante una sosta a Los Angeles. Scopre però che la ragazza è scomparsa e si ritrova costretto a collaborare con la sua ex goffa fidanzata per ritrovarla. Vivrà così una notte che cambierà per sempre la sua esistenza.

programme.title: Arrivano i dollari
programme.desc: Cinque fratelli scoprono che uno zio morto in Sudafrica ha lasciato loro in eredità una grossa somma. Ma solo liberandosi dei loro difetti potranno entrarne in possesso. Tutti cercano allora di mettersi in buona luce con la bellissima moglie dello zio cercando di ingannarla.

programme.title: L'invasione degli ultra sbronzi
programme.desc: In un villaggio irlandese si verificano degli strani avvenimenti: alcuni pescatori sono scomparsi nel nulla, sulle spiagge si riversano le carcasse di alcuni esemplari di balene e alcune persone muoiono in circostanze sospette.

programme.title: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Shriver
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: Ercole al centro della Terra
programme.desc: Firmato da Mario Bava, Ercole scende negli inferi tra mostri e oscurità per salvare la donna amata in una sfida oltre la morte.

programme.title: Gli amori di Ercole
programme.desc: Ercole decide di vendicare la morte della moglie, uccisa per mano di Eurito, re di Ecalia, ma tutto non è altro che un complotto ordito da un cortigiano ambizioso. Ercole finisce per innamorarsi di Deianira, che ora è una brava regina.

programme.title: La rivolta dei mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: Maciste contro i cacciatori di teste
programme.desc: Maciste guida il suo popolo lontano da un'isola devastata dalle eruzioni vulcaniche. Il viaggio li conduce in una terra dominata da tribù in guerra, dove l'eroe dovrà affrontare guerrieri e cacciatori di teste per salvare i superstiti.

programme.title: L'eroe di Babilonia
programme.desc: Nippur, legittimo erede al trono di Babilonia, torna dall'esilio per rovesciare il tiranno Balthazar e restituire libertà al suo popolo. Lungo il cammino salva Tamira, destinata al sacrificio, e guida una rivolta che culminerà nella battaglia decisiva per riconquistare il regno.

programme.title: Dio non paga il sabato
programme.desc: Good Samaritan drifter, Benny Hudson, and a stranded woman, Jenny, find themselves being tortured when they accidentally walk into a gang's hideout in a ghost town.

programme.title: Il suo nome è qualcuno
programme.desc: Finisce l'avventura di due soldati ribelli dopo la Guerra Civile.

programme.title: Una colt in pugno al diavolo
programme.desc: Scott si infiltra nella baia del fuorilegge El Condor, che sta diffondendo la paura nella regione del Mojave, attaccando i convogli di cercatori d'oro diretti verso la California. Con l'aiuto di Maya e di alcuni poveri messicani, oppressi dal bandito, Scott riuscirà a chiamare l'intervento della cavalleria e sconfiggere l'intera banda.

programme.title: SpeciL'uomo, l'orgoglio, la vendetta
programme.desc: Un valoroso soldato spagnolo si rivolge ad una vita di crimine per dimostrare il suo amore per una misteriosa e promiscua donna zingara.

programme.title: Gli fumavano le Colt... lo chiamavano Camposanto
programme.desc: John e George McIntire, due fratelli ingenui, arrivano in una città del West senza legge per ritrovare il padre. Dopo aver picchiato un membro di una banda di estorsori, si cacciano nei guai. A salvarli interviene un misterioso pistolero vagabondo disposto ad aiutarli.

programme.title: Non toccare la donna bianca
programme.desc: La battaglia di Custer e la disfatta di Little Big Horn sono ambientate nella fossa delle Halles a Parigi.

programme.title: Il mercenario
programme.desc: Un mercenario polacco e un minatore guidano una rivoluzione contro il governo oppressivo del Messico.

programme.title: Faccia a faccia
programme.desc: Un professore di storia incrocia casualmente un noto fuorilegge e finisce per guidare la sua banda.

programme.title: I quattro inesorabili
programme.desc: Quattro cacciatori di taglie del Texas cercano vendetta contro un ranger che ha scagionato il loro ricercato.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.12
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: Rock Legends
programme.desc: Scopri la vita e l'impatto culturale di queste leggendarie icone musicali, tra interviste e performance.

programme.title: Rock Legends
programme.desc: Scopri la vita e l'impatto culturale di queste leggendarie icone musicali, tra interviste e performance.

programme.title: Rock Legends

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.12
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: Brigitte Bardot: the icon of France
programme.desc: Il racconto dell'ascesa al successo del mito di Brigitte Bardot, incarnazione della sensualità femminile.

programme.title: Stelle del Grande Schermo
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.title: Stelle del Grande Schermo
